inverter.description: Enter this inverter logger's network address and printed PN. Keep the default protocol unless you have confirmed a different mode.

manual.title: MANYi Local
manual.description: Home Assistant must be reachable by the inverter loggers at the advertised LAN address and TCP port.

user.title: MANYi Local
user.description: Choose how to add your inverters.

auto.title: Find inverters
auto.description: Confirm the Home Assistant network and start searching. Keep the default ports and interval unless needed. Logger IPs and PNs are detected automatically. If nothing is found, try a deep scan.

scan_results.title: Discovered inverters
scan_results.description: Select one to three loggers. Their IPs and PNs have been verified.

not_found.title: No loggers found
not_found.description: Check that the loggers are powered on and on the same network. Retry with deep scan or configure manually.

no_interfaces.title: No network detected
no_interfaces.description: No usable IPv4 network was detected. You can enter the settings manually.

reconfigure.title: Connection settings
reconfigure.description: Change network settings or ports while keeping your configured inverters. The loggers must be able to reach the chosen TCP port.
